name: MerchSettings
description: Merch store settings (one record). Readable by everyone because the store page needs it; holds no secrets. Edited through merch-admin.

enabled.description: Store open to the public. While off, only admins can see and test it.

shipping_flat_rate.description: Shipping charged for the first item in an order.

shipping_additional_item.description: Added for each item after the first, like Printful's own first-item + additional-item shipping.

free_shipping_over.description: Free shipping when the order (after discounts) reaches this amount. 0 = never.

ship_countries.description: ISO country codes Stripe Checkout accepts.

collect_tax.description: Stripe Tax must be turned on in the Stripe dashboard first.

auto_submit.description: Send paid orders straight to Printful for printing. Off = they wait as drafts in Printful for an admin to confirm.

show_shipping_badge.description: Merch page: show the 'Shipping from $X' badge at the top. Display only.

show_member_badge.description: Merch page: show the member-discount badge at the top. Display only.

show_product_shipping.description: Merch page: show the shipping line in each product's window. Display only.

show_shipping_details.description: Merch page: show how shipping is charged in the Shipping & returns box. Display only.

show_tax_note.description: Cart: show 'Sales tax is added at checkout' when tax is on. Display only.

rates_refreshed_at.description: Last run of the daily Printful shipping-rate refresh.

rates_refresh_summary.description: What the last shipping-rate refresh did.
